department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering
semester: B.E. Computer Science and Engineering - Semester VII
objectives: Design and implement classical substitution and transposition cryptographic algorithms.
Perform cryptanalysis techniques including frequency analysis and exhaustive key search.
Understand secure hashing principles and demonstrate vulnerability to collision attacks like the Birthday Attack.

outcomes.desc: Implement classical encryption and decryption algorithms such as Caesar, Vigenère, and Transposition ciphers.
Analyze ciphertexts using statistical frequency analysis and brute-force cryptanalysis techniques.
Simulate hash collision vulnerabilities to understand cryptographic integrity and birthday attack bounds.
